claims.claim: Revenues totaled $31.6 billion.
Revenues were up 2.3% from the year-ago quarter.
Diluted EPS from continuing operations was $0.66, versus $0.62 in the year-ago quarter.
Adjusted EPS was $0.65, versus $0.54 in the year-ago quarter.
Operating income was $7.0 billion.
Adjusted operating income was $7.5 billion.
Income from continuing operations was $5.0 billion, up 3.6% year over year.
Adjusted EBITDA was $12.3 billion, up 5.2% year over year.
Cash from operating activities from continuing operations was $10.8 billion, versus $9.8 billion in the year-ago quarter.
Capital expenditures related to continuing operations were $5.7 billion.
Capital investment was $6.1 billion.
Free cash flow was $4.7 billion, versus $4.4 billion in the year-ago quarter.
AT&T added over 1 million Advanced Connectivity customers, driven by year-over-year increases in net adds across fiber, fixed wireless, and postpaid phone subscribers.
Advanced Connectivity service revenue was $23.5 billion, up 5.1% year over year.
Legacy revenues continued to decline year over year, down 25.9%, due to the decommissioning of the copper-based network.
Legacy operating income and EBITDA were $523 million, down $436 million year over year.
Latin America segment revenues were up 16.1% year over year, primarily driven by favorable foreign exchange rates and postpaid wireless subscriber growth.
Service revenue is expected to grow in the low-single-digit range annually.
Advanced Connectivity service revenue growth is expected in the mid-single-digit range annually.
Adjusted EBITDA is expected to grow in the 3% to 4% range in 2026, improving to 5% or better in 2028.
Adjusted EPS is expected to be $2.25 to $2.35 in 2026, with a double-digit 3-year CAGR through 2028.
Capital investment is expected to be in the $23 billion to $24 billion range annually during 2026-2028.
Free cash flow is expected to be $18 billion+ in 2026, $19 billion+ in 2027, and $21 billion+ in 2028.
Net debt-to-adjusted EBITDA is targeted to return to a level consistent with the 2.5x range within approximately three years following the closing of the transaction with EchoStar.
